titles.romaji: Doki Doki! Mini Mini! Kakushi Dungeon Gekijou Artist Collab
titles.native: ドキドキ！ミニミニ！隠しダンジョン劇場 アーティストコラボ

description:
Special collaboration mini anime episodes featuring the OP/ED artists of Ore dake Haireru Kakushi Dungeon as chibified characters to promote their albums.

Includes:
• Doki Doki! Mini Mini! Kakushi Dungeon Gekijou feat. Spira Spica
• Doki Doki! Mini Mini! Kakushi Dungeon Gekijou feat. Coala Mode.
